life.title: What does your typical day look like?
life.sub: Pick what fits. It helps me suggest things that make sense for you.

goals.title: What would you like Khowayk to help you with?
goals.sub: Choose as many as you like.

primary.title: Which one matters most right now?
primary.sub: We'll start there. You can change it any time.

tasks.title: Is there something you'd like to start or organize?
tasks.sub: Optional. Write it in your own words, like a course or a project.
tasks.ph: For example, the course you're taking

when.title: When would you like Khowayk to help you?
when.sub: I can suggest a good time based on your day and goal, and you can change it any time.

style.title: How would you prefer Khowayk to help?
style.sub: I'll start with this, and you can always ask for something else.

keepTasks: Keep these for my journey. You can delete them any time in My Profile.
schoolNote: If you're under 18, please use Khowayk with a parent or guardian's knowledge.
notDiagnosis: These are just goals. Choosing one doesn't say anything about your health.
settingsHint: Sound, motion, prayer times and notifications are all in My Profile whenever you want them.

suggest.after_work: A short activity after your workday could be a convenient time. You can change it any time.
suggest.after_class: A short activity after your classes could be a convenient time. You can change it any time.
suggest.bedtime: A calm few minutes before bed could fit your goal. You can change it any time.
suggest.none: I don't know enough about your day yet, so we'll keep it flexible.
